mapper.select: SELECT t.session_id AS sessionId, t.role AS lastRole, t.content AS lastContent, t.created_at AS lastTime, m.cnt AS messageCount, su.id AS userId, su.nickname AS nickname, su.mobile AS mobile, su.avatar_url AS avatarUrl FROM ai_chat_message t INNER JOIN ( SELECT session_id, MAX(id) AS maxId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ai_chat_message GROUP BY session_id ) m ON t.session_id = m.session_id AND t.id = m.maxId LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON t.session_id = su.id ORDER BY lastTime DESC
